name: Saginomiya
tagline: Shinjuku in 25 minutes and Shibuya in 34 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 34 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 34 minutes to Shibuya and 55 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 38 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 38 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 38 m to 43.1 m, a difference of 5.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 16 clinics and 17 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is つるた鷺ノ宮クリニック, about 10 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 薄病院, about 11 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Shinjuku Line.
congestion: Seibu Shinjuku Line runs at 148% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 下落合→高田馬場, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Toritsu-Kasei is ahead on quiet, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Saginomiya. It is served by the same lines as Saginomiya. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On quiet, Toritsu-Kasei comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Nogata; for how easy the shopping is, Saginomiya.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Saginomiya in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Saginomiya. To Toranomon, for instance, Nogata is 3 minutes quicker. A one-room flat costs about ¥8,000 less at Nogata. On how easy the shopping is, Saginomiya comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Shinjuku Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
